children: Costco Wholesale Corp. (COST, Financials), the membership warehouse retailer known for bulk goods and low prices, is giving Uber a much bigger place in how its customers shop.
Costco has expanded its Uber Eats partnership to 47 states from 17, bringing delivery from nearly 600 warehouses onto the platform.
Customers can order Costco's full assortment through Uber Eats, while members will verify their membership before purchasing. The partnership goes further than delivery.
Some Costco members will receive discounts on Uber One, and shoppers will also be able to buy Costco memberships directly through the Uber Eats app. That gives both companies something useful.

Costco gets another way to reach customers who increasingly expect groceries and household products at their door. Uber, meanwhile, gets one of America's largest retailers as it pushes Eats beyond restaurant delivery.
Competition is getting tougher. DoorDash, Instacart and Amazon already compete heavily for grocery orders, while Walmart is expanding its own delivery ambitions.
For Costco, the next question is whether convenience can bring in younger shoppers without weakening the membership economics behind its business.
For Uber, nearly 600 Costco locations give it another chance to become an app consumers open for much more than dinner.

title: Costco expands Uber Eats delivery to 47 states
